info.title: VietOCR Client / Raspberry / Compute v2
info.description: Approved architecture; each operation declares x-implementation. Foundation currently runs Google session verification, native Pi camera and read-only server telemetry. Planned OCR endpoints are not advertised as available by the gateway.

200.description: Process alive; does not assert database, camera or OCR readiness

get.description: Locally verify Supabase ES256 signature/claims, then verify Google provider/current session/ban in Postgres. No OCR quota charge.

200.description: Account identity, effective 500/30-or-lower policy, camera catalog and explicit ocrAvailable readiness
Configured Pi webcams; actual current JPEG dimensions, freshness, consumer count and error when available. No camera opened merely by listing.

get.description: Bearer header required (no URL tokens). Native JPEG parts with Content-Length; latest-frame buffer, bounded viewers, independent capture producer. Revalidate current Google session every 15 seconds; reconnect on JWT/session expiry or maximum 600-second stream lifetime. Slow viewers skip frames. No OCR charge.

200.description: MJPEG multipart stream, boundary=vietocr, no-store. First frame and disconnect are separate from HTTP header success.

post.description: Wait for a new native JPEG after the capture request. Return the exact frame at the UVC stream resolution, never the UI thumbnail. Client stores a private draft. Does not create an intent, upload to compute, run OCR or consume OCR quota. Bounded capture rate/concurrency applies separately.

200.description: Original compressed JPEG; next action is client draft/edit, not automatic OCR

X-Captured-Unix-Ms.description: Time frame reached the gateway; not a hardware exposure timestamp

200.description: Latest server stats or explicit offline/stale error, alarm state and pulse sequence. No OCR/account data.

post.description: Only after explicit Send. Metadata only; requestId is the per-account idempotency key. Queue intent is not a consumed OCR credit.

202.description: Durable job intent, current admission state and retry hint

200.description: Owned intent and upload readiness/lease status; excludes OCR text

delete.description: Release only pre-acceptance reservations; accepted jobs retain their credit. Compute cancellation is fenced and cooperative.

200.description: Server durable upload offset, generation and expiry

patch.description: Granted lease required; Pi relays bounded binary chunks without collecting the image. 256 KiB client chunk default; 1 MiB hard chunk cap. Offset mismatch returns 409 with authoritative durable offset. Full accepted hash/length/type/pixel validation precedes atomic quota commit.

204.description: Chunk durable; Upload-Offset header confirms next position

202.description: Complete valid image accepted, one credit committed, result location and scoped ticket available

post.description: Recheck current owner/session/ban; issue short-lived user+job+server read ticket. Never consumes OCR quota.

200.description: Trusted result origin, ticket and expiry

get.description: Direct client-initiated request to compute. Only read: ticket must bind issuer/audience/scope/user/job/server/expiry. Cannot create, upload or scale. Optional bounded long-poll wait.

200.description: Owned job state, OCR result and per-stage timings when available
Small cached host statistics; no GPU enumeration, database round trip or result content

googleSession.bearerFormat: Supabase ES256 JWT; current Google session also verified in DB

resultTicket.bearerFormat: Short-lived scoped result JWT, not a Google access token

telemetryMachine.bearerFormat: Random Pi machine credential; server stores SHA-256; read-only telemetry scope

Failure.description: 401 invalid/expired session; 403 banned/revoked; 409 conflict/stale lease; 429 quota/capacity; 503 dependency offline. Retry-After where retryable. Never includes secrets or photo/OCR content.
